content.text:
My review is complete. The document contains no liquidated damages, penalty, or early-termination-fee mechanic payable by Corio (our party, the licensee):

- **§ 4 Fees / § 17 Payment Terms**: fees are actual license, maintenance, MarketSite access, revenue-share and T&M implementation amounts. No late-payment interest, penalty or shortfall premium.
- **§ 11 Termination**: termination for uncured material breach or insolvency, with no minimum fee, accelerated fees or termination charge. Surviving payment obligations relate only to continued use of the Software.
- **Exhibit B revenue sharing**: percentage of actual revenue, with limitations that favour us; no minimum commitment or make-whole.
- **Exhibit C**: response/resolution commitments run against Commerce One, with no penalties either way.
- **§ 4.4 Audit**: the "shortfall" payment is a true-up of amounts actually owed, and the >5% underpayment trigger shifts only the *reasonable actual cost* of the examination — cost reimbursement, not a liquidated sum or penalty.

This meets the preferred position, so no redline is warranted.

input.quote: 11.2 Termination. If either party materially breaches any term or condition of this Agreement and fails to cure such breach within-thirty (30) days after receiving written notice of the breach, the nonbreaching party may terminate this Agreement on written notice at any time following the end of such-thirty (30) day period.
input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no liquidated damages, penalty or early-termination fee on Corio, the licensee/customer, so it meets the preferred position (no Customer-payable liquidated damages or penalties). Section 11.2 permits termination for uncured material breach or insolvency with no minimum fee, fee acceleration or termination charge, and Section 11.3's surviving payment obligations attach only to Corio's continued use of the Software for existing Customers. Section 4 and Exhibit B/Section 17 Payment Terms contain only actual license, maintenance, MarketSite access, percentage revenue-share and capped time-and-materials fees, with no late-payment interest or penalty rate. Exhibit B revenue sharing is a percentage of actual revenue with limitations favouring Corio and no minimum volume commitment or make-whole payment. Two mechanics were considered and are not liquidated damages: (i) Section 4.4's audit "shortfall" payment is a true-up of amounts genuinely owed, and the >5% underpayment trigger shifts only the reasonable actual cost of the examination, which is cost reimbursement rather than a stipulated sum; and (ii) Exhibit C's response and resolution commitments run against Commerce One, with no penalties flowing from Corio. Nothing approaches the walk-away territory of damages exceeding remaining contract value or triggered by minor breaches. No redline is required.
